title: (No AI) Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![An illustration of the Amazon logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/09/acastro_STK103__03.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn't sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to [_Reuters_](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/amazons-plan-own-worlds-product-data-fight-ai-shopping-agents-2026-11-13/). The project, called the "World Product Graph," is meant to make it less likely that shoppers leave Amazon to do their product research on Reddit or Google, and make it more likely shoppers end up at Amazon even if they're searching for a product sold elsewhere. The same goes for [AI agents](https://www.theverge.com/report/1015811/ai-shopping-agents-blocked-amazon-the-realreal-target-meta-muse) - if Amazon has the largest stockpile of shopping data, AI agents may rely on its index of products over others, so even people shopping with bots will end …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1033697/amazon-world-product-graph-ai-search)

title: (No AI) ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
author: Stevie Bonifield
content:
![Robot with shopping cart and background graphic of dollar signs.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/STKS539_AI_AGENTS_SHOPPING_B.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

After launching its [Dots AI agents platform](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1004096/openai-chatgpt-dots-hands-on-agent) earlier this year, OpenAI is [launching a wallet](https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-wallet/) for the agents. ChatGPT Wallet is [rolling out starting today](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001654-making-purchases-with-chatgpt-wallet) for ChatGPT Pro subscribers in the US aged 18 and older using a US billing address and "eligible US-issued American Express, Chase, Mastercard and Visa cards."

After adding a card to the wallet, your Dots agents can use it to buy things in response to your prompts, but they'll check in with you each time before checking out. OpenAI's [support page](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001654-making-purchases-with-chatgpt-wallet) says every purchase with ChatGPT Wallet requires a security check with biometric verification like Face ID or a fingerprint scan.

![A screenshot from a demo video for OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/openai-chatgpt-wallet-approval-pop-up.jpeg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100 "A screenshot from a demo video for OpenAI's ChatGPT Wallet")

> Now your dot c …

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1033425/openai-chatgpt-wallet)
